[01 — About]{.section-num}

## Background

I'm a data analyst that specializes in program evaluation, geospatial methods, and stakeholder-facing tools. I currently work at the Child Poverty Action Lab in Dallas, where I build pipelines, dashboards, and analyses that turn messy public-sector data into something decision-makers can act on.

My work has covered education, eviction, maternal health, and many other municipal data sources. I'm completing my M.S. in Social Data Analytics and Research at UT Dallas in May 2026, and I work primarily in R, Python, and SQL.
:::
